title: How Human Height Changed Around the World
character: Full-body front standing pose of a friendly young man against a plain white background, flat 2D vector style, clean minimal shapes with subtle dark contours, soft flat colors, wearing a mint-green crewneck t-shirt, straight dark charcoal trousers, and white sneakers with black accents.
voice: Bright, friendly, warm, educational, brisk, clear pacing.
music: Light upbeat lo-fi electronic instrumental with soft synth plucks at 115 BPM, quiet under narration.

scenes.vo: Have you ever wondered why humans are getting taller?

figures.pose: Young man in mint-green t-shirt and dark pants standing curiously, shrugging with a slight smile

scenes.vo: Over the last century, average height rose four inches.

figures.pose: Standing straight as his body smoothly elongates upwards with a proud smile
figures.label: Past 150 Years

icons.prompt: Flat icon of an upward growth chart arrow
icons.label: +4 inches

scenes.vo: Better childhood nutrition and healthcare drove most of that jump.
scenes.photo: Vertical close-up photo of fresh nutritious food including a glass of milk, crisp green apples, and whole grains on a clean wooden table in soft morning light

scenes.vo: Today, Dutch men stand the tallest, averaging six feet.

figures.pose: Tall confident young man standing proud in mint-green tee and dark trousers, waving cheerfully
figures.label: Netherlands

icons.prompt: Flat icon of the Netherlands flag beside a gold winner trophy
icons.label: Tallest

scenes.vo: In fact, the Dutch grew eight full inches since 1850!

figures.pose: Character stretching upward to impressive height, eyes wide in happy amazement
figures.label: +8 inches

scenes.vo: In America, men average five-nine and women five-four.

figures.pose: Young man in mint-green tee standing relaxed with hands by his sides
figures.label: US Men

figures.pose: Female counterpart character with brown hair in matching mint-green tee and dark jeans standing beside him smiling
figures.label: US Women

scenes.vo: Your genetics create your natural height potential range.
scenes.photo: Clean 3D medical render of a glowing DNA double-helix spiral floating vertically against an abstract deep navy scientific background

scenes.vo: Childhood sleep, nutrition, and activity decide where you land.

figures.pose: Character standing with perfect upright posture and a healthy energized smile

icons.prompt: Flat icon of a crescent moon with soft sleep sparkles
icons.label: Sleep

icons.prompt: Flat icon of fresh vegetables and running shoes
icons.label: Habits

scenes.vo: So where will you end up in your range?

figures.pose: Young man pointing warmly toward the camera with an engaging smile
figures.label: Your Potential

scenes.vo: And there's way more inside our app. Predict your height in TallPlan.

figures.pose: Excited happy character holding up a smartphone, gesturing enthusiastically to download
